purpose: Teach: 祐/俊/吾/遙/諒/ゆり/綾/朱

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがお友達の祐さんとサッカーを観に行かれるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is going to watch soccer with his friend Yusuke.
lines.style: Gentle, informative tone. Warm attention on Sho. Shares the news like a gift. Soft, unhurried pace—giving him space to take it in.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとお友達の俊くんと水族館に行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I went to the aquarium with Dad and my friend Shun!
lines.style: Bright, eager rush on the opening. Pride in the memory. Quick pace, natural child-enthusiasm. Small lift at the end, seeking her validation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「吾輩は猫である」の絵本を読んで下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is going to read you the picture book 'I Am a Cat.'
lines.style: Gentle, almost wistful. Unhurried delivery. Slight wonderment—noticing something tender about the moment. Measured breath, like she's savoring it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと遙ちゃんの誕生日会に行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I got to go to Haruka's birthday party with Dad!
lines.style: Rapid, gleeful onset. Bright, unguarded joy. Natural child-rhythm, stumbling slightly over the excitement. Trailing lift—waiting for her to celebrate with him.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「諒くんも誘って遊ぼう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad said he wants to invite Ryo over to play with you.
lines.style: Soft, thoughtful delivery. Careful attention—she's sharing something her dad said with care. Slight pause before 'Ryo.' Warm and steady, like she's building a small bridge.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとゆりちゃんの家にお邪魔したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad took me to visit Yuri's house!
lines.style: Quick, proud onset. Bright, unguarded energy. Child's natural pace and phrasing. Slight breathiness on the excitement. Trails off gently, inviting her to ask more.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「綾ちゃんの新しい習い事は何?」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was asking what new activity Aya has started.
lines.style: Thoughtful, conversational tone. Slight curiosity in her voice—she's relaying his question like she's thinking about it too. Unhurried, attentive pacing. Soft closing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと朱塗りの神社の写真撮ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I took a picture at a beautiful red shrine!
lines.style: Warm, proud burst at the opening. Bright child-energy, slightly breathless. Natural rhythm. Tender lingering on the memory—he's holding onto it. Soft, satisfied close.
